exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Fail 'chip select idle high' (Pins.md:151-155): the F suffix defaults low on input power loss, which selects the monitor while the host side is unpowered.
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Pins.md lines 151-155 cover only the coprocessor in reset: pads come out of reset pulled down (32 to 86 kOhm) and each chip select has an external pull-up of about 10 kOhm. In that state the host's 3.3 V rail is up, the barrier input is high and an F part's output is high; F acts only on input power loss. No line of Pins.md, IOBoard.md or Research.md (checkout fe53d3a, read 2026-10-02) states a host-side-unpowered case. In that case an F part holds CSB, SCK and SDI low. ADBMS1818 Rev. B p. 56 (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ADBMS1818.pdf, safari, HTTP 200, read 2026-10-02T07:06:16Z): in SPI mode activity on CSB or SCK wakes the port, and the differential SCK - CSB must reach VWAKE 200 mV for tDWELL 240 ns (Table 7); static low on both lines is 0 mV and no clock edge. No value read shows harm to the ADBMS1818 or to V190. The other values pass: ISO774x SLLSEP4K and ISO774x-Q1 SLLSEU0G (read 2026-10-02T07:02:55Z and 06:51:10Z); ISO6741 not re-read. JLCPCB (06:55:56Z to 06:55:57Z): C485810 1086 / 1066 at 1.7509; C5216433 1144 / 1137 at 1.9167; C2872241 125 / 99 at 2.6125; C2877510 4469 / 4454 at 1.6078. Digi-Key (07:02:40Z to 07:02:46Z): 3870, 1460, 0, 0, all Active. The drop stands only if the owner adds a host-unpowered requirement.
